Cucumber report fixtures for Gherkin scenario results (ADR-0055)

features/checkout.feature with
  messages.ndjson   Cucumber Messages 34.2.1, cucumber-js 13.3.0
                    (--retry 1 --retry-tag-filter @flaky --format message:...),
                    meta.ci populated from GitHub Actions variables. The repo
                    example-org/shop and the commit are synthetic.
  cucumber-js.json  The same run, --format json (cucumber-js dialect).
  cucumber-jvm.json Made from messages.ndjson by the official
                    io.cucumber:cucumber-json-formatter 0.4.2 (cucumber-jvm
                    dialect: a background element before every scenario).
  filtered.ndjson   --tags @flaky: 4 pickles, 1 test case.
  dry.ndjson        --dry-run: every step SKIPPED, success true.
The only edit: the run's scratch directory in stack traces was rewritten to
/home/runner/work/shop/shop.

Expected results (scenario line : example-row line):
  8      Paying by card                        PASSED
  12:18  Applying a discount code, SAVE10      PASSED
  12:19  Applying a discount code, EXPIRED     FAILED
  24     Paying with a gift card (Rule)        PASSED on attempt 1 (attempt 0 FAILED)

cck/ — samples from the Cucumber Compatibility Kit
(https://github.com/cucumber/compatibility-kit, devkit/samples), Messages 34.2.1
with incrementing ids, and their cucumber-jvm JSON from
https://github.com/cucumber/cucumber-json-formatter (testdata/compatibility-kit).
